entities.summary: William Gholston is an American former professional football player who was a defensive end for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Michigan State Spartans, and was selected by the Buccaneers in the fourth round of the 2013 NFL draft. He is currently the defensive line coach for the Sickles High School football team.
